items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the executive law, in relation to establishing a program for
the sharing of veteran contact information
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S8501

SPONSOR: BAILEY
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the executive law, in relation to establishing a program
for the sharing of veteran contact information

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

The bill allows the New York State Divisions of Veteran Services to
create a program that would share the contact information of veterans
between itself and all veteran-related programs. The bill also states
that state departments would require assisted people to provide informa-
tion regarding their veteran status.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1. The bill amends the executive law by adding a new section of
section 354-a chapter 602 which establishes a program that allows for
the contact information of veteran to respective veteran organizations.

Section 2. The Bill allows state departments to request assisted persons
to provide information regarding their veteran status. This act shall
take effect 118 days after it becomes law.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

State agencies are not required to share the contact information of
veterans that is collected bythe New York State Divisions of Veteran
Services. If this information were made available to the New York State
Division of Veteran Services, it would significantly improve the depart-
ments Veteran Engagement and outreach.

This bill proposes an amendment to Article 17 of New York States Execu-
tive .Law, that would allow the New York State Division Veteran Servies
to create a program that would maintain the contact information of the
veterans with the existing veteran related programs. The bill also
proposes that the assisted person would need to provide information
regarding their veteran status to receive the intended benefits from the
veteran-related programs.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect 118 days after it becomes law.
